description: This file is a C++ source code for a fuzzing test targeting Qpack encoder and decoder components within the QUIC protocol implementation. It sets up encoding and decoding endpoints, transmits header blocks with simulated delays, and verifies correctness of encoding/decoding cycle.

classes.name: EncodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackEncoder instance and its error delegate, providing methods to encode headers and adjust settings.

classes.name: DelayedHeaderBlockTransmitter
classes.description: Simulates delayed transmission of header blocks, maintaining order per stream, with methods to enqueue, transmit, and flush header blocks.

classes.name: VerifyingDecoder
classes.description: Decodes header blocks, verifies correctness against expected headers, and manages asynchronous decoding context.

classes.name: DecodingEndpoint
classes.description: Manages a QpackDecoder, creates VerifyingDecoders for streams, and verifies decoded headers against expectations.

classes.name: DelayedStreamDataTransmitter
classes.description: Buffers and transmits stream data (encoder or decoder stream) with delays, simulating network conditions.

methods.name: TruncateValueOnInvalidChars
methods.description: Removes invalid characters (NUL, LF, CR) from a string.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderList
methods.description: Creates a header list with randomized headers based on fuzz data.

methods.name: SplitHeaderList
methods.description:
Splits header values along '
' or ';' separators into multiple headers.
